description: Database schema definition for user-isolated AI chat persistence, token usage logging, and Cloudflare R2 optimized image storage.

storage_recommendation.media_bloat_issue: Storing raw base64 data inside the message body (NVARCHAR(MAX)) causes severe database bloat and blows up the LLM token context length.
storage_recommendation.proposed_strategy:
1. Save the generated logo bytes as a physical file on Cloudflare R2 (Free Tier gives 10 GB free storage, zero download/egress fees).
2. Store the Cloudflare R2 public URL and object key in the dedicated 'AiImages' table.
3. Save standard Markdown/HTML tags pointing to that URL (e.g., ![Generated Logo](https://pub-xxxx.r2.dev/logos/xyz.png)) inside the message Content column rather than the raw base64 string.

tables.name: AiSessions
tables.description: Tracks active/historical chat sessions for each user or business profile.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Session UUID string generated by the client or server.

columns.name: BusinessOwnerProfileId
constraints: FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES BusinessOwnerProfile(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.description: Links the chat session to the specific business owner profile for strict user-level isolation.

columns.name: Title
columns.description: Descriptive title generated from the first query.

columns.name: CreatedAt
columns.description: Timestamp when the chat session started.

columns.name: UpdatedAt
columns.description: Timestamp when the last message was exchanged.

tables.name: AiMessages
tables.description: Stores individual chat messages for each session.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Auto-incrementing unique identifier.

columns.name: SessionId
constraints: FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES AiSessions(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.description: Foreign key linking the message to its session.

columns.name: Role
columns.description: Role of the sender. Allowed values: 'user', 'assistant', 'system'.

columns.name: Content
columns.description: Text content of the message. Generated images should be formatted as markdown links (e.g. ![Logo](https://url)) referencing the Cloudflare R2 storage URL instead of embedding base64.

columns.name: CreatedAt
columns.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

tables.name: AiImages
tables.description: Stores metadata and storage links for generated logo images hosted on Cloudflare R2 to prevent database bloat.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Auto-incrementing unique identifier.

columns.name: SessionId
constraints: FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES AiSessions(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.description: Links the image to the chat session where it was generated.

columns.name: Prompt
columns.description: The detailed or enhanced prompt used to generate the image.

columns.name: StorageUrl
columns.description: The public HTTP URL pointing to Cloudflare R2 where the physical image is served.

columns.name: R2ObjectKey
columns.description: The exact object key (filename/path) within the Cloudflare R2 bucket.

columns.name: CreatedAt
columns.description: Timestamp when the image was generated and stored.

tables.name: AiAgentExecutions
tables.description: Audit log for tracking LangGraph routing decisions, API latencies, and token usages.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Auto-incrementing unique identifier.

columns.name: SessionId
constraints: FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES AiSessions(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.description: Links the execution trace to the session.

columns.name: AgentName
columns.description: Name of the executed node (e.g. 'PRICING', 'LOGO_GEN', 'MARKETING').

columns.name: InputData
columns.description: JSON representation of the agent's input state/query.

columns.name: OutputData
columns.description: JSON representation of the agent's output response.

columns.name: ExecutionTimeMs
columns.description: Time elapsed during the agent's run in milliseconds.

columns.name: CreatedAt
columns.description: Timestamp when the audit trace was written.
